name: kiwiply-monorepo
description: Kiwiply monorepo root — npm workspaces for the shared UI package(s). The web app (web/) and the extension (job-autofill/) are NOT workspace members yet; they join in W1.4 when they consume @kiwiply/ui (with their Docker/CI install changes). Until then they keep installing in isolation from their own lockfiles, so the live web build is untouched.
